source: Hand-written from the published Square Connect v2 request and response shapes. No body here was captured from a live Square account, no identifier belongs to a real merchant, location, device or payment, and no value is a credential.
webhookSigning: Webhook fixtures are stored as raw bytes and signed at test time with a fixture-only key. No Square signature key appears in this repository, and the bytes below are the bytes the verifier must see.

fixtures.name: device-code.json
fixtures.expected: CreateDeviceCode and RetrieveDeviceCode: `pair_by` is parsed from here, never assumed

fixtures.name: error-access-token-expired.json
fixtures.expected: maps to access_token_expired: refresh and retry

fixtures.name: error-access-token-revoked.json
fixtures.expected: maps to access_token_revoked: stop, and mark the connection revoked

fixtures.name: error-idempotency-key-reused.json
fixtures.expected: maps to idempotency_key_reused: our bug, must surface

fixtures.name: error-insufficient-scopes.json
fixtures.expected: maps to insufficient_scopes: never retried, the token is valid and not allowed

fixtures.name: error-rate-limited.json
fixtures.expected: maps to rate_limited: back off

fixtures.name: locations.json
fixtures.expected: the location list fetched live during pairing; never mirrored into a table

fixtures.name: merchant.json
fixtures.expected: MERCHANT_PROFILE_READ: the merchant behind a connection

fixtures.name: oauth-token-refreshed.json
fixtures.expected: refresh_token grant: a new access token, the same non-rotating refresh token

fixtures.name: oauth-token-status.json
fixtures.expected: the scopes the merchant actually granted, which the token response does not report

fixtures.name: oauth-token.json
fixtures.expected: authorization_code exchange: access token, refresh token, merchant and expiry

fixtures.name: payment.json
fixtures.expected: the retrieved Payment: amount, tip and total, and the only thing this integration posts from

fixtures.name: refund-completed.json
fixtures.expected: the retrieved Refund: the only thing in this integration allowed to say money went back

fixtures.name: refund-failed.json
fixtures.expected: REJECTED: terminal, releases the headroom it was holding, and the row is kept forever

fixtures.name: refund-pending.json
fixtures.expected: POST /v2/refunds: the create names the refund and reports PENDING; it is never itself proof the money moved

fixtures.name: terminal-checkout-canceled.json
fixtures.expected: a cancellation with Square's own reason, which the screen shows as timed out rather than as a decision

fixtures.name: terminal-checkout.json
fixtures.expected: a completed checkout: a wake-up call naming a payment, never itself the financial authority

fixtures.name: webhook-device-code-paired.json
fixtures.expected: handled: resolves a device row through the device code id

fixtures.name: webhook-oauth-authorization-revoked.json
fixtures.expected: handled: merchant id is the only tenant key it carries

fixtures.name: webhook-payment-updated.json
fixtures.expected: stored and marked processed-noop; reconciled in a later phase

fixtures.name: webhook-refund-updated.json
fixtures.expected: handled: a wake-up naming one refund, which is then re-read from Square

fixtures.name: webhook-terminal-checkout-updated.json
fixtures.expected: stored and marked processed-noop; reconciled in a later phase
